title: CrazyGames SDK v3 WebGL Bridge & Ad Placement Manager
acceptanceCriteria: CrazyGamesSDK.jslib exports Init, RequestMidgameAd, RequestRewardedAd, GameplayStart, GameplayStop, HappyTime, HasAdblock.
CrazyGamesSDK.cs provides C# singleton wrapper with #if UNITY_WEBGL && !UNITY_EDITOR blocks and desktop/editor fallbacks.
Mutes AudioListener and freezes timeScale during ad playback; restores them upon completion or error.
AdPlacementManager implements 3-minute midgame cooldown and 3 rewarded ad offers (2x Protein Rush, Instant Clean, Summon VIP).
Custom WebGL template includes crazygames-sdk-v3.js, responsive 100% viewport canvas, and gym bro loading screen.
